name: Spokane County, WA
findings: Spokane County has 1,631 nonprofit organizations. 780 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 597 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Spokane County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 88 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 88 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Union organizations stand out for civic or political action
observations.text: 7 union organizations here list civic or political action, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
